For s2(M)<1/8 and s3(A)>=1, zeroing the full physical I|J crossing leaves coefficient operator norm >7/8. Therefore one of AII, AJJ, AKK, AIK, AJK has operator norm >7/40. The argument is deterministic only and does not delete random terms.
